lines.text: @sai_front rolls a stripe of bright blue paint across a white wall, steps back, and tilts his head.
Locked off; he walks out of frame.

new_beats.text: A slow smile spreads across his face as the wet @paint_blue stripe catches the light.

writes.note: I added a moment where he smiles at the fresh stripe, so the pause before he leaves has a reason.

reply.rationale: The shot lacked a reaction between painting and exiting; one timed moment gives the product a payoff while the words stay unchanged.
